# Getting started

Before doing anything else in this repository, you MUST:

If (and only if) the directory `.ai-coding-tools/` exists in the working tree, read `.ai-coding-tools/processes/getting-started.md` and follow the steps it lists. `.ai-coding-tools/` is a developer-local tooling directory and is not tracked in this repository, so it may be absent for clones and in CI. If its absent its not an error — proceed with `README.md` alone in that case.

DO NOT skip this — it provides key information to make the session efficient and effective.
